questions.question: Can you walk us through a C++ project from your experience, such as the PulseWallet application, WakeOnLan tool, or P2P software, and describe your specific technical contributions?
Your background includes C/C++ and cross-platform development. How would you approach writing reliable C firmware for a resource-constrained automotive microcontroller?
Describe a difficult bug you diagnosed in a C++ or C# application. What tools and steps did you use to isolate the root cause and validate the fix?
How would you structure embedded control software for an actuator, such as a brushed DC motor, BLDC motor, or electronically controlled valve?
What considerations would you apply when designing real-time firmware behavior, including timing, interrupt handling, state management, and fault recovery?
Have you worked with CAN or LIN communication protocols? If so, describe the application; if not, how would you get up to speed on implementing and debugging an automotive communication interface?

This role requires close collaboration with hardware engineers. Based on your software development experience, how would you work with hardware engineers to debug a circuit-and-firmware integration issue?
What is your understanding of Automotive SPICE (ASPICE), and how would you use disciplined requirements, design, testing, and traceability practices in an embedded software project?
You have led teams on several web and software projects. How have you guided other developers through technical decisions, code quality, and delivery challenges?

Suppose a motor-control firmware feature passes basic bench tests but intermittently fails under load or at temperature extremes. How would you plan the investigation, collect evidence, and drive the issue to resolution?
